name: Missing Entanglement Event
hint: When an entanglement block links actors, at least one participating actor needs a non-empty handler for the entanglement-start event. Without that event, no behavior is defined for the entangled state and the program may not react as intended.
instruction: Add a non-empty [when entanglement started] handler to one of the participating actors and define its response to the entangled state there.
